items.name: biennale-yellow
items.title: Biennale Yellow
items.description: Video-first companion to Biennale Yellow's design.md. The unit is the frame (1920×1080). Atoms are identical and sacred — warm parchment grounds, a single deep indigo ink, solar yellow deployed as bloom / panel / tile underprint, Instrument Serif display + Archivo sans + JetBrains Mono data, 1px hairline rules as the only border, atmospheric depth (no shadows), and the bottom-right pagenum. Composition + frame scale rewritten. Restraint is the rule; motion out of scope.
